:::{#exm-countable-set}
#### Countable and uncountable sets

- $\set{1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6}$ is countable, because it is finite.
- The [non-negative integers](number-systems.qmd#def-nonnegative-integers) $\set{0, 1, 2, \ldots}$ are countably infinite:
  the sequence $0, 1, 2, \ldots$ lists them.
- The [integers](number-systems.qmd#def-integers) are countably infinite too:
  the sequence $0, 1, -1, 2, -2, 3, -3, \ldots$ lists every one of them.

:::
